messages:
Rae (CS): Heads-up: PolarisHealth renewal in ~5w. Noticed a 55% drop in API calls last 14d. They also opened a ticket about "intermittent truncation" and slow tails on /v1/chat. Procurement asked for a short perf + reliability note for their RFP.
Tom (Solutions): Oof. Do we have sample request IDs or bound to a particular model?
Rae (CS): They attached two request IDs in the ticket and said issues mainly on their staging cluster between 09:30-10:15 ET. New procurement contact is non-technical (Asha P.). Their ML lead (same as before) is on gardening leave, so we need a clear procurement-friendly summary + an ops checklist.
Priya (Eng): Likely victims: cold KV cache + occasional batch timeouts. Small bursty test traffic often degrades embeddings and chat because batch_size collapses to 1. Can you paste the samples?
Rae (CS): Pasted samples from support bundle:
```
2026-02-25T14:33:01Z ERROR 500 generation_service - kv_cache_miss seq=0 latency=2.3s
2026-02-25T14:38:07Z WARN 504 stream_terminate - client_closed_stream request_id=abc123
```
Tom (Solutions): Suggest immediate plays: 1) offer 2-week trial of a small dedicated pool during their evaluation window; 2) provide quick client-side tweaks (reduce max_wait to 25ms, enable streaming retry) and a one-pager for procurement; 3) run a short repro on our staging with their traffic profile.
Ben (AE): Procurement will want numbers. Can you include cost delta (hosted vs small-dedicated) and expected p50/p95 improvements? I'll push for trial over discount.
Priya (Eng): I'll spin a synthetic replay against staging to validate KV cold-start behavior and measure tail latency. ETA 6h. If we see batch timeout, we can temporarily bump their tenant concurrency and lower per-request wait to reduce single-request timeouts.
Rae (CS): Calendar-bot: please propose a 30m sync with Polaris procurement and their PM tomorrow 11:00 ET.
calendar-bot: Meeting invite sent to Asha P., Polaris PM, Rae (CS), Ben (AE). 11:00 ET tomorrow.
Ben (AE): I'll join and try to surface their RFP scoring criteria. If NimbusCloud is in the mix, we should emphasize predictable latency and our stabilization offer.
Tom (Solutions): I'll draft a 1-page exec summary aimed at procurement (non-technical) + a 1-page ops checklist for their ML engineer. Will include fallback model-variant and rollback steps.
Rae (CS): Action items: Tom - exec + ops one-pagers (owner: Tom) due EOD; Priya - reproduce + logs + config patch (owner: Priya) due in 6h; Ben - confirm competitive set and procurement asks (owner: Ben) due before meeting; Rae - consolidate support examples and send invite (owner: Rae).
Priya (Eng): Repro plan started. If we reproduce, I'll also capture a short perf run showing p50/p95 before/after proposed config.
Rae (CS): Also they reported a truncated response example in ticket (I'll paste now).
Rae (CS): "Response ended mid-sentence: \"...please confirm the patient transa\""
Priya (Eng): That looks like early stream termination. Could be client-side timeout or server buffer flush on error. Please ask for client SDK version.
Ben (AE): We'll ask on the call. If procurement asks for an SLA, escalate and we can offer a 2-week stabilization SLA tied to the dedicated trial rather than a price cut.
Tom (Solutions): Draft uploaded: https://docs.company/polaris/renewal-triage-onepager-draft. PTAL @Rae @Ben.
Rae (CS): Reviewed, left a short blurb about monitoring alerts and a recommended triage cadence (daily for first 7 days, then bi-weekly).
Tom (Solutions): Updated. Added cost delta table and quick commands for their infra team to run simple repros.
Priya (Eng): If we can't repro, request a short capture (curl + headers) from their staging during the 09:30-10:15 ET window and we can do live debugging on the call.
Rae (CS): Good. Will request the curl examples in the meeting invite.
Ben (AE): :thumbsup: Let's try the operational trial first. Will report back after the call.
Rae (CS): Thanks team 64f Will update thread after meeting.
